components.name: Exact restricted witness precision for a high-quality abc state
components.project_addition: For the exact high-quality state 2+3^10*109=23^5, derive the prime-coordinate relation and degeneracy rows, give an explicit unimodular basis of the additive witness lattice that isolates the forbidden-sublattice coordinate, prove by a ten-case integer interval certificate that no non-degenerate witness has L-infinity radius <=600, and exhibit a radius-601 witness. This yields mu=601 versus arithmetic-demand floor lambda_abc=597 and naive two-coordinate ceiling U2=59049. Arithmetic derivatives, restricted successive minima, and lattice reduction remain prior art; the fixed-instance certificate and its integration with P025 precision layers are project results with historical priority unverified.
